all_seasons.use: forward-looking artifacts only; no number in this repo is reported from it on the test seasons

model_selection.method: season-blocked validation inside the development seasons: fit on every development season before the block, score the block; log loss pooled over blocks
model_selection.rule: keep the configured variant unless another has a lower pooled log loss by more than one standard error of the paired difference (games as units)

field_goal_tail.note: tail_0_yards is the hard cap at the longest made kick. The comparison rests on the handful of attempts beyond that kick in each block.

field_goal_model.miss_rule: opponent takes over at the spot of the kick (8 yards behind the line of scrimmage) or its own 20, whichever is farther from its goal line
opponent takes over at the spot of the kick (8 yards behind the line of scrimmage) or its own 20, whichever is farther from its goal line

field_goal.log_loss_with_hard_cap_note: diagnostic only, to show what the fade-out tail is worth on these seasons; the tail was fixed in the config before this score and is not chosen from it

punt.note: log loss is over 100 outcomes (the receiving team's yard line, 0 = return touchdown); each distribution is mixed with 1% uniform

play_model.event: gain reaches the line to gain (or touchdown) without a turnover

kickoff_sensitivity.what: expected points, single-drive problem with optimal fourth downs; empirical kickoff table against a fixed start at the touchback spot

drive_targets.note: real data, not model output; the simulator is compared with these in M4 (test seasons out of sample, recent development seasons in sample)

figure_data.go_note: raw rates: development seasons, plays between the 20-yard lines; fitted_same_plays: the model's fourth-down probability (last season, spread 0) averaged over the field positions of the raw fourth-down plays at that distance
figure_data.punt_note: raw: seasons from 2018, yard lines with 20+ punts; net = receiving team's yardline_100 at its next snap minus (100 - yardline_100); a return touchdown counts as yardline 0
